name: plasticity
description: Brain-like long-term memory for Claude Code: a knowledge graph of neurons (decisions, facts, rationales, procedures) with Hebbian learning and interference-based forgetting. Recalls relevant memories on every prompt.

scope.title: Memory scope
scope.description: global: one memory shared by all projects; project: one memory per git repository

recall_limit.title: Memories per prompt
recall_limit.description: Maximum number of memories injected with each prompt

reflect.title: End-of-task reflection
reflect.description: Once per session, after substantive work, ask Claude to store durable knowledge and report used memories

embeddings.title: Semantic search
embeddings.description: auto: download a local embedding model (~90 MB, all-MiniLM-L6-v2) on first use; ollama: use a local Ollama server; off: keyword search only

log.title: Event log
log.description: Keep a local log of recalls and learning for evaluation (plasticity log, plasticity eval report)
